translation: n. （病毒、细菌、动植物的）品系，毒株，品种；压力，负担；扭伤，拉伤；拉力，张力；（常作复数）旋律，曲调　v. 拉伤，扭伤（肌肉等）；竭力，尽力；拉紧；过滤；使（关系）紧张
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: (n.) a particular variety or type of a virus, bacterium, plant or animal; a pressure or demand that makes something difficult to bear; an injury caused by stretching a muscle too far. (v.) to injure a body part by stretching it too much; to make a very great effort; to pour liquid through a sieve to separate the solid parts; to make a relationship difficult or tense.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （常用复数 strains）乐曲的旋律，曲调片段
uncommonMeanings.example: The strains of a violin drifted out of the hospital window. 小提琴的旋律从医院窗口飘了出来。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 过滤，滤去（液体中的固体）
uncommonMeanings.example: Strain the soup carefully before you give it to the patient. 把汤仔细滤一遍再端给病人。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （家族或性格中的）遗传特质，一股…劲儿
uncommonMeanings.example: There is a strain of stubbornness running through the whole family. 这一家人身上都有一股倔劲儿。

posExamples.sentence: Researchers soon identified a more infectious strain of the virus.
The sudden wave of patients put a heavy strain on hospitals.
Volunteers strained every nerve to deliver food before dark.

collocations.translation: 一种新型冠状病毒毒株
collocations.example: Covid-19 is caused by a new strain of coronavirus. 新冠肺炎由一种新型冠状病毒毒株引起。
A drug-resistant strain spread quickly through the ward. 一种耐药菌株在病房里迅速扩散。
The outbreak put a strain on the whole health system. 疫情给整个医疗系统造成了沉重负担。
The nurses worked under great strain for three months. 护士们在巨大压力下连续工作了三个月。
He strained a muscle while carrying supplies upstairs. 他把物资搬上楼时拉伤了肌肉。
She strained her ears to catch the doctor's low voice. 她竖起耳朵才听清医生的低语。
Weeks of lockdown strained relations between the neighbours. 数周封控使邻里关系变得紧张。

collocations.phrase: strain every nerve to do sth
collocations.example: Doctors strained every nerve to save the elderly patient. 医生们竭尽全力抢救那位老年病人。

wordForms.noun: strain 毒株／压力／拉伤；strainer 滤网，漏勺
wordForms.verb: strain 拉伤，竭力，过滤（规则变化：strain-strained-strained）；同源 restrain 抑制，constrain 限制
wordForms.adjective: strained 疲惫紧张的；不自然的（strained relations 紧张的关系；a strained smile 勉强的笑容）
wordForms.other: ①一词多义提醒：n. 毒株／压力／（复数）旋律；v. 拉伤／竭力／过滤。②辨析 strain vs sprain：strain a muscle 拉伤肌肉肌腱，sprain one's ankle 扭伤脚踝关节。③辨析 strain vs stress vs pressure：stress 侧重精神压力，pressure 侧重外来施压，strain 强调超负荷后产生的紧张与损耗。④表"毒株"时为可数名词：a new strain of coronavirus / several strains of flu virus；表"压力"时可数不可数皆可（put a strain on… / be under strain）。

classPractice.question: After three weeks in the ICU, the young doctor's face looked pale and ______ (strain).
classPractice.note: strain 的形容词 strained 表"疲惫紧张的、不自然的"，与 pale 并列作 looked 的表语；strained 还可修饰关系（strained relations 关系紧张）。

classPractice.question:
连续数月的超负荷工作给医护人员造成了巨大压力。
Months of overwork ______ a huge ______ on medical workers.
classPractice.answer: put / strain（Months of overwork put a huge strain on medical workers.）
classPractice.note: put a strain on sb/sth 是固定搭配，strain 此处为可数名词"压力、负担"，前可加 huge/heavy/enormous；注意与"毒株"义 a strain of coronavirus 区分。

translation: n. 疫苗，菌苗
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: a substance that is put into a person's or an animal's body, usually by injection, to protect them from a disease by making the body produce antibodies.

posExamples.sentence: Two doses of this vaccine protect most people for about a year.
The vaccine has to be stored at a very low temperature.
A safe and effective vaccine gave the whole community fresh hope.

collocations.example: Teams worked day and night to develop a vaccine. 各团队夜以继日地研制疫苗。
There is still no perfect vaccine against the common cold. 至今仍没有防治普通感冒的完美疫苗。
People over sixty received the vaccine first. 六十岁以上的人先接种疫苗。
The second dose of vaccine is given three weeks later. 第二剂疫苗在三周后接种。
The country rolled out the vaccine to remote villages. 该国把疫苗推广到偏远村庄。
Older people are advised to have a flu vaccine every autumn. 建议老年人每年秋天接种流感疫苗。
Clinical trials of the vaccine involved forty thousand volunteers. 该疫苗的临床试验有四万名志愿者参与。

collocations.translation: 疫苗犹豫（对接种的迟疑）
collocations.example: Doctors used simple facts to overcome vaccine hesitancy. 医生用简明的事实打消人们对疫苗的疑虑。

wordForms.noun: vaccine 疫苗（物）；vaccination 疫苗接种（事）
wordForms.verb: vaccinate 给…接种疫苗（规则变化：vaccinate-vaccinated-vaccinated；vaccinate sb against sth）
wordForms.adjective: vaccinated 已接种的；unvaccinated 未接种的
wordForms.other: ①词源：源自拉丁语 vacca"母牛"，因 Jenner 用牛痘（cowpox）制成人类第一支疫苗。②三词辨析：vaccine 是"物"（一支疫苗），vaccination 是"事"（接种这一行为），injection 指打针这个动作。③可数名词：a vaccine, two vaccines；作定语可说 vaccine rollout、vaccine passport。④介词固定用 against：a vaccine against the virus；"接种疫苗"说 have/get/receive a vaccine 或 be vaccinated，不用 eat/drink。

classPractice.question: Millions of people were ______ (vaccine) against Covid-19 within just a few months.
classPractice.note: 名词 vaccine → 动词 vaccinate；"某人被接种"用被动 be vaccinated against sth，介词只能用 against。

classPractice.question:
在创纪录的时间里，科学家们研制出了一种抗冠状病毒的疫苗。
Scientists ______ ______ ______ against the coronavirus in record time.
classPractice.note: develop a vaccine 表"研制疫苗"（不用 invent，疫苗属研发而非发明）；vaccine 可数，此处首次提及用不定冠词 a；in record time 意为"以创纪录的速度"。

translation: adj. 警觉的，警惕的；（头脑）机敏的，反应快的　v. 向…报警；提醒，使意识到　n. 警报；戒备（状态）；（手机、系统的）提示消息
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: (adj.) quick to notice and react to anything unusual or dangerous; (v.) to warn someone about a possible danger or problem so that they are ready for it; (n.) a warning of danger, or a state of readiness to deal with danger.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【医学】（伤病员）神志清醒、有反应的（常与 conscious 连用）
uncommonMeanings.example: When the ambulance arrived, the injured man was still conscious and alert. 救护车到达时，伤者仍然神志清醒、有反应。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （手机或系统推送的）提示信息，通知
uncommonMeanings.example: Health alerts kept popping up on everyone's phone. 健康提示不断弹出在每个人的手机上。

posExamples.sentence: Stay alert to early signs such as a sore throat.
The nurse alerted the doctor to a sudden drop in blood pressure.
The city remained on high alert as cases rose again.

collocations.example: Doctors were alert to the first signs of the new strain. 医生对这种新毒株的最初迹象保持警觉。
Stay alert and keep washing your hands. 保持警惕，坚持洗手。
Nurses were on the alert for patients with high fevers. 护士们警惕着出现高烧的病人。
An app alerted us to a close contact on the bus. 一款应用提醒我们注意公交车上的密接情况。

collocations.translation: 红色警报，最高级别警戒
collocations.example: The district issued a red alert after twenty new cases. 该区在新增二十例后发布了红色警报。
Enough sleep keeps your mind alert in class. 充足的睡眠能让你上课时头脑清醒。
A young doctor was the first to sound the alert. 一位年轻医生最先拉响了警报。

wordForms.noun: alert 警报，戒备；alertness 警觉，机敏
wordForms.verb: alert 向…报警，提醒（规则变化：alert-alerted-alerted；alert sb to sth）
wordForms.adjective: alert 警觉的；机敏的
wordForms.other: ①一词三类同形，句法各不相同：adj. be alert to sth；v. alert sb to sth（不能说 alert sb sth）；n. 多用于 on the alert / a red alert / sound the alert。②辨析 alert / aware / vigilant：aware 只表"知道、意识到"，alert 强调察觉后能立刻反应，vigilant 更书面，指长时间持续戒备。③重音在第二音节 a-LERT /əˈlɜːt/，勿读成首重音。④alert 作 adj. 通常作表语或前置定语（an alert student 机灵的学生）。

classPractice.question: Her ______ (alert) saved the whole ward from a serious infection.
classPractice.note: 空前有形容词性物主代词 Her，且作句子主语，须填名词 alertness"警觉、机敏"；alert 本身作名词时意为"警报"，与句意不符。

classPractice.question:
一条手机推送提醒居民注意附近的疫情。
A phone message ______ residents ______ the outbreak nearby.
classPractice.note: alert sb to sth 是固定结构，to 为介词不可省，也不可换成 of；主句时态为一般过去时，故用 alerted。

translation: n. 止痛药，镇痛剂
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: a drug or medicine that takes away or reduces physical pain.

posExamples.sentence: Take one painkiller every six hours and never exceed the dose.
Painkillers may damage the liver if taken in large amounts.
She kept a small packet of painkillers in her first-aid kit.

collocations.example: He took a painkiller and lay down quietly. 他吃了片止痛药，安静地躺下。
The doctor prescribed a strong painkiller after the operation. 医生在手术后开了强效止痛药。
Over-the-counter painkillers are sold without a prescription. 非处方止痛药无需处方即可购买。
Excessive use of painkillers can irritate the stomach lining. 过量使用止痛药会刺激胃黏膜。

collocations.translation: （一段时间内）一直在服用止痛药
collocations.example: She has been on painkillers ever since the operation. 手术之后她一直在服用止痛药。
When the painkiller wore off, the pain came back. 止痛药药效一过，疼痛又回来了。
Some patients become addicted to painkillers after long treatment. 一些病人在长期治疗后对止痛药上瘾。

wordForms.noun: painkiller 止痛药；pain 疼痛，痛苦
wordForms.verb: （无对应动词；表"止痛"用 kill/relieve/ease the pain）
wordForms.adjective: painful 疼痛的，令人痛苦的；painless 无痛的
wordForms.adverb: painfully 疼痛地；令人痛苦地
wordForms.other: ①构词法：pain（疼痛）+ kill（消灭）+ -er（施动之物）→ painkiller；同类"宾语+动词+er"复合名词：lifesaver 救生员／救命之物、timekeeper 计时员、peacemaker 调解者、troublemaker 捣乱者。②可数名词，复数 painkillers，泛指止痛药时常用复数。③同义表达：pain reliever（美式常用）、analgesic /ˌænəlˈdʒiːzɪk/（医学术语）。④注意 -less 后缀的 painless 是"无痛的"，不要与 painkiller 混用。

classPractice.question: 用 painful / painless / painkiller 填空：The injection itself was quick and almost ______, but the wound became so ______ at night that she had to take a ______.
classPractice.note: 同一词族三形：-less 表"无…的"→ painless 无痛的；-ful 表"充满…的"→ painful 疼痛的；pain + killer 表"止痛之物"→ painkiller，第三空前有 a，须填可数名词单数。

classPractice.question:
医生给她开了一种强效止痛药，并提醒她一天不要服用超过三次。
The doctor ______ her a strong ______ and warned her not to take it more than three times a day.
classPractice.answer: prescribed / painkiller（The doctor prescribed her a strong painkiller and warned her not to take it more than three times a day.）
classPractice.note: prescribe sb sth = prescribe sth for sb"给某人开（药）"；painkiller 为可数名词，被 a strong 修饰用单数；"服药"用 take，不用 eat。

translation: n. 食欲，胃口；（对某事物的）强烈渴望，浓厚兴趣
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: the physical feeling that makes you want to eat; also a strong desire or enthusiasm for something.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【商业·金融】（承担风险、投入资金的）意愿，偏好，如 risk appetite 风险偏好
uncommonMeanings.example: The bank has little appetite for risky loans this year. 该银行今年不太愿意做高风险贷款。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （常用复数 appetites）（对食物、享乐等的）各种欲望
uncommonMeanings.example: He has slowly learned to control his appetites. 他慢慢学会了克制自己的种种欲望。

posExamples.sentence: A high fever often leaves patients with no appetite at all.
Her appetite for learning grew during the months of online classes.
Fresh air and exercise gave the children healthy appetites.

collocations.example: She lost her appetite the day the fever began. 发烧那天她就没了胃口。
The patient has a poor appetite but sleeps well. 这位病人胃口不好，但睡得不错。
Don't eat sweets now; you'll spoil your appetite. 现在别吃糖，会影响你吃饭的胃口。

collocations.translation: 对…的强烈渴望／浓厚兴趣
collocations.example: The volunteers showed a huge appetite for helping strangers. 志愿者们表现出极强的助人热情。

collocations.translation: 吊起某人的兴趣，勾起某人的胃口
collocations.example: The trailer whetted everyone's appetite for the new film. 那段预告片吊起了大家对这部新片的兴趣。
A long walk helped him work up an appetite. 走了很远的路让他有了胃口。
Doctors advised him to curb his appetite for salty food. 医生建议他控制对咸食的偏好。

wordForms.noun: appetite 食欲，渴望；appetizer（英式亦作 appetiser）开胃菜，开胃品
wordForms.verb: （无对应动词；"开胃、勾起兴趣"用 whet the appetite，whet-whetted-whetted）
wordForms.adjective: appetizing 开胃的，诱人的；unappetizing 倒胃口的
wordForms.other: ①拼写与重音：ap-pe-tite /ˈæpɪtaɪt/ 重音在首音节，中间是 -pe- 不是 -pi-，词尾 -tite 读 /taɪt/。②可数名词：a good appetite / different appetites。③介词固定用 for：an appetite for knowledge，不可用 of/to。④辨析：appetite 指生理食欲或对某物的强烈渴望；hunger 指饥饿感；craving 指难以抑制的嗜求；desire 泛指愿望。

classPractice.question: The chicken soup smelled so ______ (appetite) that even the feverish boy asked for more.
classPractice.note: 名词 appetite → 形容词 appetizing"开胃的、诱人的"；smell 为系动词，后接形容词作表语，so...that... 引导结果状语从句。

classPractice.question:
那本关于这场疫情的书吊起了我对医学的兴趣。
The book about the pandemic ______ my ______ for medicine.
classPractice.note: whet sb's appetite for sth 意为"勾起某人对某事物的兴趣"，whet 的过去式为 whetted（重读闭音节双写 t）；appetite 后接 for，不能用 to。

translation: adj. 无价的，贵重到无法估价的；极其珍贵的；（非正式）极其滑稽的，令人捧腹的
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: so valuable that it is impossible to calculate a price for it; (informal) extremely funny or amusing.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【非正式】太逗了，极其滑稽的（多用于形容表情、说法）
uncommonMeanings.example: The look on his face when he saw the bill was priceless. 他看到账单时的表情太逗了。

posExamples.sentence: The courage shown by those nurses was simply priceless.
Good health is priceless; no amount of money can buy it.
The museum lost several priceless paintings in the fire.

collocations.example: That bronze vase is a priceless treasure. 那只青铜瓶是无价之宝。
Working as a volunteer gave me priceless experience. 做志愿者给了我极其宝贵的经历。
Those handwritten letters are priceless to her. 那些手写的信对她来说无比珍贵。
Meeting the frontline doctors was a priceless opportunity. 见到一线医生是个千载难逢的机会。
Neighbours' small kindnesses proved priceless during the lockdown. 封控期间邻里的小小善意被证明极其宝贵。
The gallery houses a priceless collection of Tang pottery. 这家美术馆藏有一批无价的唐代陶器。
His imitation of the head teacher was absolutely priceless. 他模仿班主任的样子简直太逗了。

wordForms.noun: price 价格；pricelessness 无价（罕用）
wordForms.verb: price 给…定价，标价（The book is priced at 30 yuan.）
wordForms.adjective: priceless 无价的；pricey/pricy 昂贵的（口语）；valuable 有价值的；worthless / valueless 毫无价值的
wordForms.other: ①反直觉陷阱：-less 通常表"没有…的"（homeless 无家可归的），但 priceless 不是"没有价值"，而是"贵重到无法标价"；表"毫无价值"要用 worthless 或 valueless。同类反直觉词：invaluable 极宝贵的（≠ 没价值）。②三词辨析：valuable 值钱的、有价值的（可比较，very valuable）；priceless 贵重到无法用钱衡量（一般不用 very 修饰，用 absolutely/simply）；invaluable 多修饰帮助、建议、信息等抽象事物，指"非常有用"。③构词：price（n./v.）+ -less → priceless。

classPractice.question: 用 priceless / worthless 填空：Good health is ______, while a fake vaccine is not only ______ but also dangerous.
classPractice.note: priceless 表"贵重到无法标价"，褒义；worthless 才表"毫无价值的"，贬义。切勿因 -less 后缀而把 priceless 误解成"没有价值的"。

classPractice.question:
在那些艰难的日子里，邻里之间的相互扶持是无价的。
In those hard days, the support neighbours gave one another ______ ______.
classPractice.answer: was priceless（In those hard days, the support neighbours gave one another was priceless.）
classPractice.note: the support (that) neighbours gave one another 是省略了关系代词的定语从句，主语中心词 support 为不可数名词，谓语用单数 was；priceless 作表语，不用 very 修饰。

translation: adj. 谨慎的，小心的，慎重的；（表态、估计）有保留的，不把话说满的
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: careful to avoid possible danger, risk or mistakes; sometimes deliberately restrained so as not to promise or claim too much

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （用于评价、欢迎、估计等）有保留的，留有余地的，不把话说满的（cautious optimism / a cautious welcome / a cautious estimate）
uncommonMeanings.example: The minister gave the reopening plan a cautious welcome. 部长对复课计划表示了有保留的欢迎。

posExamples.sentence: Be cautious about forwarding health advice you cannot verify online. 转发你无法核实的健康建议时要谨慎。
Doctors remain cautious although new infections have fallen for weeks. 尽管新增感染已连续数周下降，医生们仍持谨慎态度。
Cautious shoppers checked the expiry date on every box of masks. 谨慎的顾客把每盒口罩的保质期都查了一遍。

collocations.example: Parents were cautious about sending their children back to school. 家长们对送孩子返校一事持谨慎态度。
Be cautious of strangers selling so-called free vaccine pills. 要提防兜售所谓免费疫苗药丸的陌生人。
There is cautious optimism that the outbreak is easing. 人们谨慎乐观地认为疫情正在缓解。
The city took a cautious approach to reopening schools. 该市对学校复课采取了谨慎的做法。
Some students think the campus rules are overly cautious. 有些学生觉得校园规定过于谨慎。
A cautious estimate puts the number of volunteers at 3,000. 保守估计志愿者有三千人。
Even after recovery, patients should stay cautious. 即使康复之后，患者也应保持谨慎。

wordForms.noun: caution（谨慎，小心；警告）; precaution（预防措施，常用复数 precautions）
wordForms.verb: caution（告诫，警告：caution sb against doing sth）
wordForms.adjective: cautious（谨慎的）; incautious（不谨慎的，较少用）; precautionary（预防性的：precautionary measures）
wordForms.other: 构词：caution（谨慎）+ -ous（形容词后缀）。介词辨析：be cautious ABOUT doing sth 指自己做事时小心；be cautious OF sb/sth 指提防某人某物。名词短语 with caution 相当于副词 cautiously（慎重地），说明书上常见；take precautions against sth 表『采取措施预防某事』。cautious 是以 -ous 结尾的双音节形容词，比较级、最高级只能用 more cautious / most cautious，不能写成 cautiouser。

classPractice.question: Nurses moved ____ (cautious) between the beds so as not to wake the sleeping patients.
classPractice.note: 空格修饰实义动词 moved，须用副词 cautiously；cautious 是形容词，只能修饰名词或作表语。

classPractice.question: 面对新变种，专家们对疫苗的效果表示谨慎乐观。Faced with the new variant, experts expressed ____ ____ about the vaccine.
classPractice.note: cautious optimism 是『形容词+名词』的固定搭配，表『谨慎乐观』；若改用形容词结构则说 were cautiously optimistic about the vaccine。

translation: n. 便宜货，特价商品；协议，交易　vi. 讨价还价，商谈（价钱或条件）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: (n.) something bought for less than its usual price, or an agreement in which each side promises to do something for the other; (vi.) to discuss prices or conditions in order to reach an agreement

uncommonMeanings.meaning: bargain for / on sth：预料到，指望（多用于否定句，或 more than sb bargained for）
uncommonMeanings.example: The volunteers got more than they bargained for. 志愿者们遇到的麻烦比他们预想的多得多。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 廉价的，特价的（bargain price / bargain offer / bargain hunter）
uncommonMeanings.example: She bought the winter coat at a bargain price. 她以特价买下了这件冬衣。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: into the bargain（英式）：而且，此外（用于补充一个额外的好处或坏处；美式说 in the bargain）
uncommonMeanings.example: This mask is cheap, and washable into the bargain. 这种口罩便宜，而且还可水洗。

posExamples.sentence: At ten yuan a box, those masks were a real bargain. 十元一盒，那些口罩真是便宜货。
We made a bargain: I cook, and my brother shops. 我们说好了：我做饭，弟弟去采买。
The two sides bargained for hours over the price of ventilators. 双方就呼吸机的价格谈了好几个小时。

collocations.translation: 真正的便宜货，很划算的东西
collocations.example: This second-hand microscope is a real bargain. 这台二手显微镜真是便宜货。

collocations.phrase: strike / make a bargain with sb
collocations.example: The town struck a bargain with a local factory to supply masks. 镇上与当地一家工厂达成协议供应口罩。

collocations.translation: 讨价还价很厉害，在条件上寸步不让
collocations.example: The supplier drove a hard bargain over delivery dates. 供货商在交货日期上寸步不让。

collocations.phrase: bargain with sb over / about sth
collocations.translation: 就某事与某人讨价还价
collocations.example: She bargained with the driver about the fare all the way to the station. 一路到车站，她都在跟司机讲价钱。

collocations.phrase: keep one's side of the bargain
collocations.example: He kept his side of the bargain and stayed home for fourteen days. 他信守约定，在家待满了十四天。
Nurses won better pay through collective bargaining. 护士们通过集体谈判争取到了更好的待遇。
Small clinics have little bargaining power with big suppliers. 小诊所在大供应商面前几乎没有议价能力。

wordForms.noun: bargain（便宜货；协议）; bargaining（讨价还价，谈判，不可数）; bargainer（谈判者，较少用）
wordForms.adjective: 没有独立的形容词形式；bargain 直接作定语表『特价的』：a bargain price / bargain offer
wordForms.other: 读音提醒：重音在第一音节 /ˈbɑːɡən/，第二音节弱读为 /ən/，不读作 gain /ɡeɪn/。语法提醒：bargain 作动词是不及物动词，与人、事搭配须带介词——bargain with sb over / about / for sth，不能说 bargain sth。名词 bargain 可数：a bargain / bargains。近义辨析：bargain 侧重『为价钱讨价还价』，negotiate 更正式且可及物（negotiate a deal / a contract）。

classPractice.question: The volunteers ____ (bargain) with several factories before the masks were finally donated.
classPractice.note: 全句讲述过去那段经历，before 从句已用过去时，主句同用一般过去时 bargained；bargain 是不及物动词，与人搭配必须说 bargain with sb。

classPractice.question: 他们和这家药店达成了协议：先供货，月底付款。They ____ ____ ____ with the pharmacy: goods first, payment at the end of the month.
classPractice.note: strike / make a bargain with sb 表『与某人达成协议』，此处用过去式 struck 或 made；bargain 表『协议』时可数，前面要加 a。

translation: n. 诡计，骗局，伎俩；把戏，戏法；窍门，诀窍；恶作剧　vt. 欺骗，哄骗
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: (n.) a clever act or plan intended to deceive someone, to entertain people, or to make something easier to do; (vt.) to deceive someone, especially in order to get something from them

uncommonMeanings.meaning: do the trick：奏效，管用，解决问题
uncommonMeanings.example: A spoonful of honey should do the trick for a sore throat. 一勺蜂蜜应该就能治好嗓子痛。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 用来骗人的；特技的（a trick question 有陷阱的问题；trick photography 特技摄影）
uncommonMeanings.example: That was a trick question with no correct answer at all. 那是个根本没有正确答案的陷阱题。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （牌戏中的）一墩牌，一圈（一轮打出的牌）
uncommonMeanings.example: She won the last three tricks and the whole game. 她赢下最后三墩牌，也赢了整局。

posExamples.sentence: Scammers used a simple trick to steal people's vaccine appointment codes. 骗子用一个简单的伎俩窃取了人们的疫苗预约码。
Older nurses taught us little tricks for calming frightened patients. 老护士教了我们一些安抚受惊病人的小窍门。
He was tricked into paying for medicine that never arrived. 他被骗付了钱，药却始终没送到。

collocations.translation: 捉弄某人，对某人搞恶作剧
collocations.example: Don't play tricks on the nurses; they are exhausted. 别捉弄护士们，他们已经精疲力尽了。
The email tricked her into clicking a fake link. 那封邮件骗她点开了一个假链接。
The caller tricked the old man out of his savings. 打电话的人骗走了老人的积蓄。
Selling fake test kits during a pandemic is a dirty trick. 大疫当前兜售假检测试剂是卑鄙的手段。

collocations.phrase: the trick is to do sth
collocations.example: The trick is to keep the mask tight over your nose. 诀窍在于让口罩紧贴鼻梁。
A retired doctor taught the volunteers the tricks of the trade. 一位退休医生把看家本领教给了志愿者。
He cheered up the children in the ward with a card trick. 他用一个纸牌戏法逗乐了病房里的孩子。

collocations.translation: 上某人的当，中某人的圈套
collocations.example: Many people fell for the same trick twice. 许多人在同一个骗局上栽了两次。

wordForms.noun: trick（诡计；戏法；窍门）; trickery（欺骗手段，不可数）; trickster（骗子，耍花招的人）
wordForms.adjective: tricky（棘手的，难对付的；狡猾的）
wordForms.other: 拼写：trick 以 -ck 结尾，加 -ed/-ing 不双写辅音，写作 tricked / tricking。考点提醒：形容词 tricky 在高考中更常考『棘手的、难处理的』义（a tricky situation / question），而非『狡猾的』。搭配对比：trick sb INTO doing sth（骗某人做某事）↔ trick sb OUT OF sth（骗走某人财物）。注意 trick question（陷阱题，名词作定语）≠ tricky question（难题）。

classPractice.question: Fake charity messages ____ (trick) hundreds of donors into sending money last spring.
classPractice.note: last spring 表明用一般过去时；trick sb into doing sth 中 into 是介词，后面接动名词 sending。

classPractice.question: 用 trick / cheat 的适当形式填空，并补出必要的介词：He ____ me ____ signing the paper, and later he even ____ in the final exam.
classPractice.note: trick sb into doing sth 表『骗某人做某事』，trick 及物，后跟介词 into＋动名词；cheat 表『（考试中）作弊』时是不及物动词，说 cheat in / on an exam，不能说 cheat sb into doing sth。cheat 若要表『骗取』则用 cheat sb out of sth。

translation: n. 受害者，受难者；（疾病、事故、灾难的）患者，遇难者，灾民；牺牲品
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: a person who has been harmed, injured or killed as a result of a crime, disease, accident or disaster, or who suffers because of someone else's actions

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （古代祭祀中）献给神的祭品，牺牲（词的本义，今多见于历史或宗教语境）
uncommonMeanings.example: In ancient rituals a lamb was offered as a victim. 在古代祭祀中，人们把羔羊作为祭品献上。

posExamples.sentence: Volunteers delivered hot meals to victims of the outbreak every evening. 志愿者每天傍晚给疫情中的受害者送热饭。
Police say the victim of the phone scam lost her savings. 警方说这起电话诈骗的受害者损失了全部积蓄。
Most flood victims were housed in the school gym overnight. 大多数洪灾灾民当晚被安置在学校体育馆。

collocations.translation: 成为…的受害者；患上（疾病），遭受（灾难）
collocations.example: Thousands fell victim to the new strain within weeks. 数千人在几周之内感染了这种新毒株。
The pandemic has claimed victims in every province. 这场大流行在各省都夺去了人的生命。
Children are the innocent victims of every epidemic. 孩子是每一场疫情中无辜的受害者。
People from all walks of life donated to the earthquake victims. 各行各业的人都为地震灾民捐款。

collocations.translation: 环境（时运）的牺牲品，身不由己的人
collocations.example: Far from being a criminal, he was a victim of circumstances. 他远非罪犯，只是环境的牺牲品。

collocations.translation: 装可怜，把自己说成受害者
collocations.example: Instead of apologising, he played the victim. 他非但不道歉，反而装起可怜来。

collocations.phrase: a victim of one's own success
collocations.example: The donation hotline became a victim of its own success. 这条捐赠热线因太受欢迎而不堪重负。

wordForms.noun: victim（受害者，牺牲品）; victimization / victimisation（受害，受迫害）
wordForms.verb: victimize / victimise（使受害；欺凌，不公正地对待）
wordForms.adjective: victimized（受欺凌的、被不公正对待的）; victimless（无受害者的：a victimless crime）；没有常用的 -ic / -ful 形容词形式
wordForms.other: 词源提示：victim 来自拉丁语 victima『祭品』，与 victor（胜利者）、victory（胜利，源自 vincere 征服）不同源，拼写相近但词义无关，勿混。语法提醒：固定短语 fall victim to sth 中 victim 前不加冠词；单独作表语时必须加冠词，如 He became a victim of the disease. 可数名词，复数为 victims。

classPractice.question: The outbreak had claimed over two thousand ____ (victim) by the end of March.
classPractice.note: over two thousand 后接可数名词复数 victims；claim victims 意为『夺去…的生命』，注意别误写成 victors（胜利者）。

classPractice.question: 去年冬天，我的两位邻居成了这种病毒的受害者。Last winter two of my neighbours ____ ____ ____ the virus.
classPractice.note: fall victim to sth 是固定搭配，victim 前不加冠词（即使主语是复数也说 fell victim to）；last winter 提示用过去式 fell。

translation: n. 目击者，见证人；（法庭）证人；证据，证明　vt. 目击，亲眼看到；（时代、地点）见证…的发生；为（文件、签名）作见证
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: (n.) a person who sees something happen or who gives evidence in a court of law; (vt.) to see something happen, or (of a time or place) to be the setting in which something important happens

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （以时间、地点作主语）见证，经历（某事发生）——写作高频用法
uncommonMeanings.example: The year 2020 witnessed the fastest vaccine development in history. 2020 年见证了史上最快的疫苗研发。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （在文件上）为签名作见证，见证签署
uncommonMeanings.example: A teacher witnessed her signature on the consent form. 一位老师为她在同意书上的签名作了见证。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 证据，证明（多用于 bear witness to sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: The empty streets bore witness to people's fear. 空荡的街道见证了人们的恐惧。

posExamples.sentence: Police asked every witness to describe exactly what they had seen. 警方请每位目击者准确描述他们所看到的情况。
We witnessed neighbours leaving vegetables at the doors of quarantined families. 我们亲眼看到邻居把蔬菜放在隔离家庭的门口。
That spring witnessed an outpouring of help from ordinary citizens. 那个春天见证了普通市民涌泉般的援助。

collocations.example: She was the key witness in the fraud case. 她是那起诈骗案的关键证人。
He was a witness to the whole rescue. 他见证了整个营救过程。
The court called the nurse as a witness. 法庭传这位护士出庭作证。
These medals bear witness to the doctors' courage. 这些奖章见证了医生们的勇气。
Interns witnessed the epidemic first-hand in the ward. 实习生在病房里亲身目睹了这场疫情。
The police took a witness statement from the driver. 警方录取了司机的证词。
Our city witnessed the birth of a nationwide volunteer network. 我们这座城市见证了一个全国志愿者网络的诞生。
Her eyewitness account moved the whole class. 她作为目击者的叙述打动了全班同学。

wordForms.noun: witness（目击者，证人；证据）; eyewitness（目击者）
wordForms.adjective: 无常用形容词形式（不存在 witnessful / witnessable 这类词）
wordForms.other: 语法提醒：witness 作动词是及物动词，直接接名词或名词短语——witness an accident / witness sb doing sth，不能说 witness to do sth；作名词表『目击者』时常与介词 to 连用：a witness to the accident。拼写：名词以 -ss 结尾，复数加 -es，写作 witnesses。写作提分点：用『时间/地点 + witness + 名词』替换 There be 或 happen，如 The past decade has witnessed...；时间地点作主语时只能用主动语态，不可写成 was witnessed。

classPractice.question: The past century ____ (witness) several major flu pandemics across the world.
classPractice.note: the past century 表『从过去延续到现在的一段时间』，常与现在完成时连用，故填 has witnessed；时间段作主语表『见证』时只能用主动语态，不能写成 has been witnessed。

classPractice.question: 这位老人是那场事故唯一的目击者。The old man was the only ____ ____ that accident.
classPractice.note: witness 作名词表『目击者』时后接介词 to；the only 后接单数可数名词，故用 witness 而非 witnesses。

translation: n. 影响，作用，效果；冲击，撞击（力）　vt. & vi. 对…产生影响；撞击
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: (n.) the powerful effect that an event, person or policy has on a situation, or the force with which one object hits another; (v.) to have a strong effect on someone or something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 撞击，碰撞（力）；on impact 意为『碰撞的一瞬间，一撞上就』
uncommonMeanings.example: The bottle of alcohol shattered on impact with the floor. 那瓶酒精一落地就摔碎了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使紧压嵌入；impacted 指（智齿等）阻生的、嵌塞的（医学用语）
uncommonMeanings.example: The dentist removed an impacted wisdom tooth. 牙医拔掉了一颗阻生智齿。

posExamples.sentence: Vaccines have had an enormous impact on the death rate. 疫苗对死亡率产生了巨大影响。
School closures impacted children's mental health more than anyone expected. 停课对孩子心理健康的影响超出了所有人的预料。
The helmet cracked, but it absorbed most of the impact. 头盔裂了，但它吸收了大部分冲击力。

collocations.example: Small daily habits have a real impact on public health. 日常的小习惯对公共卫生有实实在在的影响。

collocations.translation: 产生影响，留下深刻印象
collocations.example: The young volunteers really made an impact in that village. 那些年轻志愿者在那个村子里确实产生了影响。
The outbreak has had a far-reaching impact on daily life. 这场疫情对日常生活产生了深远的影响。

collocations.phrase: cushion / soften the impact of sth
collocations.example: Government aid cushioned the impact of the lockdown on small shops. 政府补助缓和了封控对小店铺的冲击。
Rising cases are impacting on hospital services. 病例上升正在影响医院的各项服务。
The new factory must pass an environmental impact assessment. 这家新工厂必须通过环境影响评价。
Engineers examined the point of impact carefully. 工程师仔细检查了撞击点。

wordForms.noun: impact（影响；撞击）
wordForms.adjective: impactful（有影响力的，较新且偏口语，考试作文慎用）; impacted（受影响的；（牙）阻生的）
wordForms.other: 重音规律：名词读 ˈimpact（重音在前），动词读 imˈpact（重音在后），与 record、increase、export 同属『名前动后』的重音移位规律。搭配要点：名词固定说 have an impact ON sth，介词只能用 on，不能用 to / for；动词既可及物（impact sth），也可说 impact on sth（英式更常见）。impact 表『影响』时通常可数，前面要加 a / an 或 the，如 a huge impact；只有 little / no / much impact 等少数量词搭配中才不加冠词。

classPractice.question: Last spring their donations ____ (impact) thousands of families in record time.
classPractice.note: 时间状语 last spring 明确指向过去，用一般过去时 impacted；impact 作动词可直接接宾语，也可说 impacted on thousands of families（英式用法）。

classPractice.question: 志愿者的到来对这个社区产生了深远的影响。The arrival of the volunteers ____ ____ profound impact ____ this community.
classPractice.note: have an impact on sb/sth 是固定搭配；impact 表『影响』时可数，前加 a（a profound impact），介词只能用 on，不能换成 to 或 for；主语中心词是 arrival，动词用单数过去式 had。

translation: vt. & vi. 夸大，夸张，言过其实 vt. 使更明显，放大（差异、缺点、特征）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to make something seem larger, better, worse or more important than it really is; also, to make a feature or difference more noticeable than it usually is.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使…更明显，放大（差距、特征、缺陷）——不含“说谎”之意，指客观上凸显
uncommonMeanings.example: The pandemic exaggerated the gap between rich and poor districts. 这场大流行放大了贫富城区之间的差距。

posExamples.sentence: Some websites exaggerated the danger of the new strain and spread panic. 一些网站夸大了新毒株的危险，散播恐慌。
He always exaggerates when he talks about his weeks in quarantine. 他一讲起隔离的那几周就总爱夸张。
Weeks of night shifts exaggerated the shadows under her eyes. 连续数周上夜班使她的黑眼圈更加明显。

collocations.example: Rumours exaggerated the risk of the vaccine. 谣言夸大了疫苗的风险。

collocations.translation: 大大夸大，严重言过其实
collocations.example: The death figures posted online were grossly exaggerated. 网上发布的死亡数字被严重夸大了。

collocations.translation: 往往言过其实，惯于夸张
collocations.example: People tend to exaggerate when they are frightened. 人在害怕时往往会夸大其词。

collocations.phrase: It is impossible/hard to exaggerate the importance of sth
collocations.translation: 再怎么强调…的重要性也不为过
collocations.example: It is impossible to exaggerate the importance of hand hygiene. 手部卫生的重要性再怎么强调也不为过。

collocations.translation: 毫不夸张地说（名词形式作状语）
collocations.example: Without exaggeration, this was the busiest winter of her life. 毫不夸张地说，这是她一生中最忙的一个冬天。
An exaggerated report of shortages emptied every shelf. 一则夸大缺货的报道让货架全空了。
The real heroes never exaggerate their own role. 真正的英雄从不夸大自己的作用。

collocations.phrase: It is no exaggeration to say that ...
collocations.translation: 说…毫不夸张（名词固定说法）
collocations.example: It is no exaggeration to say that the small clinic saved hundreds of lives. 说这家小诊所挽救了数百条生命，毫不夸张。

wordForms.noun: exaggeration 夸张，夸大；夸大的说法（It is no exaggeration to say that ...）
wordForms.verb: exaggerate 夸大，夸张（规则变化：exaggerated / exaggerating）
wordForms.adjective: exaggerated 夸大的，言过其实的；（动作、表情）夸张的
wordForms.other: 构词法：ex-（向外）+ agger（堆，heap）+ -ate → 越堆越高 → 夸大。拼写陷阱：中间双 g、单 r（exa-gg-e-r-ate；名词 exaggeration 同样只有一个 r）。句法：exaggerate 及物时直接接宾语，不说 exaggerate about sth；不及物时单独使用（He's exaggerating.）。

classPractice.question: Without ____ (exaggerate), the doctors in that ward worked over twelve hours a day.
classPractice.note: 介词 without 后须接名词，动词 exaggerate → 名词 exaggeration（注意只有一个 r）；without exaggeration 意为“毫不夸张地说”，作句首状语。

classPractice.question:
有些广告大大夸大了这种保健饮料的功效。
Some advertisements ____ ____ the effects of the health drink.
classPractice.note: exaggerate 为及物动词，直接跟宾语 the effects，不能写成 exaggerated about；greatly / grossly / wildly 是它最常见的程度副词搭配；全句叙述过去，用过去式 exaggerated。

translation: n.（尤指因缺钱、缺物造成的）艰难，困苦，苦难（不可数）；[C] 造成困苦的具体难事、苦难经历（常用复数 hardships）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: a situation in which life is difficult or unpleasant, especially because you do not have enough money, food or comfort; (countable) a particular thing that causes such difficulty.

posExamples.sentence: Many small families faced real financial hardship during the long lockdown. 长期封控期间，许多小家庭陷入了真正的经济困难。
The young doctors shared the hardships of the villagers they served. 年轻医生们与他们服务的村民同甘共苦。
Years of hardship never weakened her trust in her neighbours. 多年的困苦从未削弱她对邻里的信任。

collocations.example: Months of closure pushed the corner shop into financial hardship. 数月停业让街角小店陷入经济困难。
Frontline nurses endured great hardship far from home. 一线护士远离家乡，忍受了巨大的艰辛。
Sudden travel bans caused hardship to migrant workers. 突如其来的出行禁令给外来务工者造成了困难。
In times of hardship, people from all walks of life pull together. 在困难时期，各行各业的人们齐心协力。

collocations.translation: 战争／封控带来的种种苦难（可数复数）
collocations.example: Her grandmother often spoke of the hardships of war. 她奶奶常提起战争年代的种种苦难。

collocations.translation: （正式，多见于法律与公文）过重的负担，过度的困难
collocations.example: The new fee should not impose undue hardship on poor students. 这项新收费不应给贫困学生带来过重负担。

collocations.translation: 困难补助基金／艰苦地区津贴
collocations.example: The university set up a hardship fund for stranded students. 学校为滞留学生设立了困难补助基金。

wordForms.noun: hardship 艰难，困苦；苦难经历（抽象义不可数，具体难事可数 hardships）
wordForms.adjective: hard 艰难的，困难的（hardship 的词根）
wordForms.adverb: hard 努力地，猛烈地；hardly 几乎不（两者含义完全不同，勿混）
wordForms.other: 构词法：hard + -ship（表“状态、身份”的名词后缀，同类：friendship, membership, leadership, championship）。可数性：表抽象“困苦”不可数，不加 a、不加 -s（great hardship）；指一件件具体难事时可数（the hardships of war）。hardship 没有对应动词，harden（使变硬／变冷酷）由 hard 派生，与之无义项关联；hardy（能吃苦的，耐寒的）源自古法语 hardi，不是 hard 的派生词，不要当成 hardship 的形容词形式。搭配陷阱：不说 a hardship life，应说 a life of hardship 或 a hard life。

classPractice.question: The family went through years of ____ (hard) after the flood destroyed their farm.
classPractice.note: 介词 of 后须接名词；hard 加名词后缀 -ship 构成 hardship，表抽象“困苦”时不可数，故不加 a、不加 -s。

classPractice.question:
疫情期间，许多小店面临严重的经济困难。（用 hardship）
____
classPractice.answer: During the pandemic, many small shops faced serious financial hardship.
classPractice.note: financial hardship 为不可数用法，前面不加 a；face / suffer / experience hardship 均为常见搭配（不说 meet a hardship）；注意 shops 用复数，faced 用过去式。

translation: n. 织物，布料，纺织品；[sing.]（社会、生活、制度的）结构，根基，肌理；[sing.]（建筑物的）主体结构
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: cloth made by weaving or knitting; (singular) the basic structure that holds a society, a system or a building together.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （社会、生活的）结构，根基，肌理——熟词僻义，常与 society, community, daily life 连用
uncommonMeanings.example: The long outbreak tore at the social fabric of the neighbourhood. 长期的疫情撕扯着这个社区的社会肌理。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （建筑物的）主体结构，即墙体、地板与屋顶
uncommonMeanings.example: Damp has damaged the fabric of the old hospital building. 潮气损坏了这座老医院大楼的主体结构。

posExamples.sentence: Masks made of tightly woven fabric can block most droplets. 用密织布料做成的口罩能挡住大部分飞沫。
Two months of silence tested the very fabric of city life. 两个月的沉寂考验着城市生活的根基。
Repairs to the fabric of the school hall cost a fortune. 修缮学校礼堂的主体结构花费不菲。

collocations.example: She lined the winter coat with soft cotton fabric. 她用柔软的棉布给冬衣做了衬里。

collocations.translation: 一块／一段布料（不可数时的量词说法）
collocations.example: The tailor cut a length of fabric into twenty narrow strips. 裁缝把一段布料剪成了二十条窄条。
Synthetic fabric dries faster than cotton. 合成面料比棉布干得快。

collocations.phrase: the fabric of society / the social fabric
collocations.example: Mutual help strengthened the fabric of society during the outbreak. 疫情中的互助加固了社会的肌理。

collocations.phrase: be woven into the fabric of sth
collocations.translation: 融入…之中，成为…不可分割的一部分
collocations.example: Care for neighbours is woven into the fabric of this old town. 关照邻里已融入这座老城的肌理。
Rumours can damage the fabric of public trust. 谣言会破坏公众信任的根基。
The fire spared the fabric of the building. 大火没有伤及建筑主体。
She added fabric softener to the last rinse. 她在最后一遍漂洗时加了柔顺剂。

wordForms.noun: fabric 织物；（社会、建筑的）结构｜fabrication 捏造，编造；伪造品；（部件的）制作
wordForms.verb: fabricate 编造（谎言、借口、证据）；制造，组装
wordForms.adjective: fabricated 编造的，虚构的；预制的（prefabricated 预制的）
wordForms.other: 词源：拉丁 fabrica（作坊、工艺）→ 做出来的东西 → 布料 → 引申为“结构”。可数性：泛指“布料”不可数（soft cotton fabric, a piece of fabric）；指某一种面料或多种面料时可数（a light waterproof fabric / natural fabrics）。指“社会／建筑结构”永远用单数且加 the（the fabric of ...）。辨析陷阱：fabric 是名词，fabricate 才是动词“编造”；勿与 factory（工厂）、fable（寓言）混淆。

classPractice.question:
邻里互助早已融入这座城市的肌理。
Helping one's neighbours has long been ____ ____ ____ ____ of this city. （weave, fabric）
classPractice.note: 固定表达 be woven into the fabric of sth；weave 的过去分词是不规则形式 woven（weave-wove-woven），此处与 has been 构成现在完成时的被动；fabric 前必须加 the。

classPractice.question: 用 fabric / fabricate 的适当形式填空：The scarf is made of soft, light ____, and the reporter later admitted that he had ____ the whole interview.
classPractice.note: 第一空由形容词 soft, light 修饰且无冠词，需不可数名词 fabric（面料）；第二空在 had 之后须用过去分词，动词 fabricate（编造）→ fabricated，与 admitted 构成“过去的过去”。

translation: vt. 把…看作，将…视为（regard sb/sth as）；（以某种方式）看待；（书面语）注视 n. 尊敬，敬重；关心，顾及；（复数 regards）问候，致意；方面，点（in this regard）
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to think of somebody or something in a particular way; (noun) respect or admiration for somebody, attention or care given to something, or friendly greetings sent to somebody.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 注视，端详（书面语，常带方式状语）
uncommonMeanings.example: She regarded the crowded ward in silence. 她默默地注视着拥挤的病房。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 关心，顾及（多用于 without regard for / have regard to）
uncommonMeanings.example: He kept delivering medicine without regard for his own safety. 他不顾自身安危，一直坚持送药。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 问候，致意（regards，书信与口头均可）
uncommonMeanings.example: Please give my regards to the nurses on your ward. 请代我问候你病房里的护士们。

posExamples.sentence: Most parents regard vaccination as the safest way to protect children. 多数家长把接种疫苗视为保护孩子最安全的方式。
The old village doctor is held in high regard by everyone here. 这位老村医受到这里每个人的敬重。
In this regard, ordinary volunteers taught us more than experts. 在这一点上，普通志愿者比专家教给我们的更多。

collocations.example: People soon regarded mask-wearing as a basic courtesy. 人们很快把戴口罩视为一种基本礼貌。

collocations.translation: 被普遍认为是（被动结构）
collocations.example: That vaccine team is widely regarded as the country's best. 那支疫苗团队被普遍认为是全国最优秀的。

collocations.translation: 以惊恐／怀疑的态度看待某事
collocations.example: Villagers first regarded the new strain with alarm. 村民们起初对这种新毒株充满惊恐。
The whole street holds those delivery riders in high regard. 整条街的人都很敬重那些送货骑手。
With regard to travel, the rules changed almost weekly. 关于出行，规定几乎每周都在变。
In that regard, the community's response was remarkable. 在那一方面，这个社区的反应堪称出色。
She worked double shifts without regard for her own health. 她连上两班，全然不顾自己的身体。
Give my regards to your grandparents when you call. 你打电话时代我向祖父母问好。

wordForms.noun: regard 尊敬；关注，顾及；(pl.) regards 问候
wordForms.verb: regard 视为；看待；（书面语）注视（规则变化：regarded / regarding）
wordForms.adverb: regardless 不管怎样，仍然（regardless of + 名词／what, how 引导的从句 = 不顾，不管）
wordForms.other: 词源：re-（回）+ gard（= guard 看守）→ 回头看 → 注视 → 看待。句法辨析：regard sb as sth 中 as 不可省；同构的还有 think of / look on / view sb as；而 consider 可说 consider him (to be) a hero，不必加 as。介词短语易错点：with regard to 不加 s，as regards（关于）必须加 s；另有 regarding prep. 关于。名词 regards 只在“问候”义上用复数。

classPractice.question: Those night-shift cleaners are rarely ____ (regard) as heroes, but no hospital could run without them.
classPractice.note: be regarded as 是 regard sb as sth 的被动形式，主语 cleaners 是被“视为”的一方，故用过去分词 regarded 与 are 构成被动语态；as 不能省略。

classPractice.question:
关于疫苗，专家提醒我们不要轻信谣言。
____ ____ ____ the vaccine, experts warn us not to believe rumours.
classPractice.note: with regard to = 关于（正式语域），后接名词或动名词；注意此处 regard 不加 s（只有 as regards 才带 s），且不能写成 with regard of。

translation: vt. 拖，拽；硬拉（某人）去；拖长，使拖延 vi.（时间、活动）过得缓慢，拖沓；（衣物等）拖在地上 n. 拖累，累赘；[U]（空气、水的）阻力；（非正式）令人厌烦的人或事
sub_section: 补充词汇（课件重点·非词汇表）
definitionEn: to pull somebody or something along with effort and difficulty; (of time or an event) to pass or continue slowly and boringly; (noun) something that holds back progress, or the force of air or water that slows a moving object down.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （时间、会议等）过得极慢，令人难熬地拖着
uncommonMeanings.example: The last week of quarantine really dragged. 隔离的最后一周过得格外难熬。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 拖累，累赘（a drag on sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Poor internet access became a drag on online teaching. 网络不畅成了网课的一大拖累。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 讨厌的事，无聊的人
uncommonMeanings.example: Staying indoors for six weeks was such a drag. 关在家里六周实在无聊透了。

posExamples.sentence: He dragged heavy boxes of medicine up six flights of stairs. 他把一箱箱沉重的药品拖上了六层楼。
The empty afternoons dragged, and no one knew when it would end. 空荡荡的下午过得极慢，没人知道何时是尽头。
Cyclists wear tight clothing to reduce air drag. 骑行者穿紧身衣是为了减小空气阻力。

collocations.example: Two nurses dragged the oxygen cylinder into the ward. 两名护士把氧气瓶拖进了病房。

collocations.translation: （不及物）拖沓地持续，拖延下去
collocations.example: The lockdown dragged on for another month. 封控又拖了一个月。
Don't drag out the meeting; the volunteers are exhausted. 别把会议拖长了，志愿者们都累坏了。
Some countries dragged their feet over sharing vaccines. 一些国家在共享疫苗上一直拖着不动。
Don't drag me into your argument about masks. 别把我卷进你们关于口罩的争论。
The long closure was a drag on small businesses. 长期停业成了小微企业的拖累。
Exhausted, she dragged herself out of bed for the night shift. 她累极了，还是硬撑着起床去上夜班。
Just drag and drop the file into the shared folder. 把文件拖放到共享文件夹里就行。

wordForms.noun: drag 拖累，累赘；（空气、水的）阻力；（非正式）讨厌的事
wordForms.verb: drag 拖，拽（不规则拼写变化：过去式／过去分词 dragged，现在分词 dragging）
wordForms.adjective: dragging（时间、疼痛）持续而缓慢的，拖沓的（a dragging pain 隐隐持续的钝痛）
wordForms.other: 拼写规则：单音节词，词尾为“辅+元+辅”，加 -ed/-ing 须双写 g → dragged / dragging。读音辨析：drag /dræɡ/ 与 drug /drʌɡ/（药品）拼写、读音都不同，勿混。语法分工：drag on 不及物，主语是时间／事件本身（The meeting dragged on.）；drag sth out 及物，主语是人，指故意拖长；另有 drag sth up 意为“翻出（旧事）”，不是“往上拖”。

classPractice.question: The talks ____ (drag) on for weeks before the two sides finally reached an agreement.
classPractice.note: before 从句用一般过去时，主句也须用过去式；drag 词尾“辅+元+辅”须双写 g 变 dragged；drag on 为不及物短语，意为“拖沓地持续”，主语是 talks 本身，后面不能再接宾语。

classPractice.question:
有关部门在处理这起投诉上仍然拖拖拉拉。
The department is still ____ ____ ____ over the complaint.
classPractice.note: drag one's feet = 故意拖延；one's 必须与主语一致，主语 the department 为单数无生命，用 its；is still 后接现在分词，双写 g 写作 dragging。
